summary: Phase 18 end-to-end testing — Stellar wallet provisioning with pending→active lifecycle. All 8 pytest backend cases passed (default chain, wallet pending→active, refresh-wallet-status, deposit-while-pending race + release, webhook idempotency, dispatch table, phase 14/15/16/17 regression). Frontend verified across rampa page (arsa-addresses-panel with issuer/SAC/Base addresses and 'no es Soroban' clarification), admin client → Cuenta Andes tab (badge=WALLET·ACTIVA, refresh button working, stellar.expert explorer link), client portal in both wallet states (banner appears+buttons disabled when pending, banner hidden + buttons enabled when active; NO Memo/destination tag ever shown). Mock gateway 800ms auto-activate race exercised — held deposit was correctly flipped to Success+released_at on wallet.active with balance bumping to 12345. org_seed_alemany ramp account & wallet restored to active state before finishing. No test_p18_* leftovers in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: ramp_routes.py is now ~1000+ lines; consider splitting wallet-status enrichment, account CRUD, and balances/movements into separate modules for maintainability.

Mock gateway 800ms auto-activate timer is hardcoded in andes-gateway/src/server.ts — consider making it configurable via env (ANDES_MOCK_WALLET_ACTIVATE_MS) so tests can shrink/expand the race window deterministically without code change.

Held-deposit release relies on _handle_wallet_active scanning ramp_movements with held_for_wallet_activation=true — confirm an index exists on (provider_user_id, held_for_wallet_activation) to avoid coll-scan as volume grows.

Idempotency for /internal/ramp/webhook is keyed on delivery_id; second call returned {ok:true, duplicate:true} as expected. Consider also asserting signature in non-dev mode (currently signature_valid:true is accepted from request body — trust boundary depends on X-Internal-Token only).
seed_data_creation: Test ECIDs under prefix test_p18_* (auto-cleaned in finally). org_seed_alemany ramp_wallets temporarily flipped to status=pending to assert client-portal banner, then RESTORED to status=active with activated_at=2026-06-03T09:47:20Z. Final DB state: 0 test_p18 accounts, 0 p18_user wallets, alemany seed wallet active.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 18 fully green. Gateway still in MOCK mode (ANDES_GATEWAY_MODE=mock); mock auto-fires wallet.active 800ms after POST /wallets for Stellar. For deposit-while-pending race testing, gateway POST /dev/fire-webhook with X-Internal-Token within ~700ms window of /accounts creation reliably reproduces the held movement → released flow. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase18_wallet_activation.py is the regression suite — re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_phase18_wallet_activation.py -v.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 18 surface area.
